Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The Pacemaker cluster resource manager is a collection of technologies working together to maintain data integrity and application availability in the event of failures.

This update fixes the following bug:

* During a network split, bundle cannot be stopped due to unresolvable transition (BZ#1770734)

Users of pacemaker are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix this bug.
